title: Organization MFA posture evidence file
description: Self-attested MFA enforcement posture for a source-code organization (GitHub Org, Azure DevOps Org, or AWS IAM). Place at .oss-policy-kit/evidence/org-mfa-posture.json. Trust level: self-attested (maintainer-supplied, not platform-verified).

schema_version.description: Schema identifier for this evidence file format.

attested_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the maintainer last verified these settings.

attested_by.description: Username or identifier of the person attesting this file.

org_name.description: Name of the organization this evidence applies to.

platform.description: Platform where the organization is hosted.

mfa_required_for_all_members.description: Whether MFA is required for all organization members (not just admins).

mfa_required_for_admins.description: Whether MFA is required for all organization administrators.

sso_enforced.description: Whether SSO is enforced for access (optional, provides stronger assurance).

phishing_resistant_mfa.description: Whether phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn/FIDO2) is required (optional, highest assurance).

enforcement_scope.description: Optional. Describes who MFA enforcement actually covers. Only `all_members` is treated as full enforcement; `admins_only`, `selected_teams`, and `partial` downgrade the control to MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about deviations, exceptions, or context.
